remarks: Custom built by Mattera Construction, this exceptional home offers over 11,000 sq ft+/- of refined living on 1.3 private acres in the highly sought-after Sturges Commons neighborhood, known for its strong sense of community and block gatherings. Recently enhanced w/ a brand-new, top-of-the-line cedar wood roof, the home blends timeless craftsmanship w/ modern luxury. The main level is ideal for both elegant entertaining & everyday living, featuring a chef's kitchen with Wolf/Subzero appliances, an inviting family room w/ fireplace, a richly detailed library w/ custom cabinetry, a gracious living room, & large sun filled dining room that can comfortably accommodate 12. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features architectural ceilings, fireplace, a stunning dressing room, a spa-like bath, & private study. Four additional en-suite bedrooms & a second family room complete the level. The third floor offers a large playroom w/ a walk-in closet & full bath. The walk-out lower level delivers exceptional recreation w/ a private theater, gym, & multiple spaces for games, crafts, & entertaining. Outdoor living rivals a resort, featuring a pool w/ spa, covered terrace w/ fireplace, outdoor kitchen w/ BBQ, & a full-size sport court. A rare opportunity to own a thoughtfully designed home offering scale, comfort, & lifestyle in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods. Minutes from all amenities yet situated on a lot with exceptional privacy, this home is not to be missed!
